name: fig-03
title: The cellular interface

purpose.mechanism: The minimal cellular interface: a cell exposes physical exchange ports (chemical, mechanical, electrical, thermal) and higher-level cellular ports (growth rate, shape, signaling, objective, viability).

config.caption: The minimal cellular interface: a cell exposes physical exchange ports (chemical, mechanical, electrical, thermal) and higher-level cellular ports (growth rate, shape, signaling, objective, viability).

Time series of the runnable fig03 cellular interface (fig03-runnable): a bounded cell senses its environmental drivers and its typed interface ports respond. A chemical supply drives Monod uptake and growth (the cell accretes volume), while a thermal driver held ABOVE the cell's 37 °C optimum (45 °C) drives viability strictly down by first-order Arrhenius thermal death — drivers → ports made runnable. From scripts/build_fig03_dynamics.py.

question: What ports and contract define the minimal cellular interface?
